target_customer: Outpatient healthcare practices and provider groups, plus revenue cycle teams making payer calls
problem: Practices lose time and money to phone based admin: scheduling, benefits checks, prior authorizations and claims follow-up.
business_model: B2B SaaS for AI voice agents, priced by usage or contract

founders.name: Xavier de Gracia
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was VP/GM of a 120M dollar business unit running call centers.

founders.name: Josep Mingot
founders.background_notes: Product leader per YC page and a16z.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time voice agents with EHR integrations and payer phone trees were feasible with 2023 LLM and speech APIs, but integration breadth and reliability were hard.

defensibility.rationale: Underlying models are shared; moat comes from EHR integrations, operations and customer data, which others can replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Healthcare voice vendors competed in later years; no acquisition of Prosper reported.

market_need_then: Both founders cite call center experience; the site claims 200B dollars of admin overhead yearly (company claim). No dated 2023 source for need was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses getprosper.ai, not prosper.com, which belongs to an unrelated lender.

identity.mascot_or_character: named agent personas such as Maria and Anna
identity.visual_style: red and white accents on dark backgrounds with beige photo backdrops
identity.voice_and_tone: direct short fragments, 'It's not magic. It's Prosper AI.'

branding.brand_signature: It's not magic. It's Prosper AI. tagline

brand_strength.rationale: Positive word but shared with Prosper Marketplace and others, forcing a get prefix domain; no evidence of brand driven growth.

outcome_analysis: Prosper reached 60 people by the directory data and raised a 5M seed in September 2025 and a 30M a16z led Series A in June 2026. Coverage reports revenue growing 4x since Q2 2025 and EHR integrations with 80 plus systems. Voice AI tailwinds and the founders' call center operating experience fit the success story; the claims are company reported.
notes: Series A cross-checked by a16z, The Next Web and trade press; round date is the a16z post date 2026-06-22. One outlet called the 2025 round pre-seed; the cited outlet says seed. Total about 35M per press. Founding year 2023 per YC page; one source says 2024. Competition: only undated 2026 vendor listicles and one undated Hello Patient launch piece found, so list left empty.
